TC-07/S16.title: Send the task list to a covering colleague in-app; both sides keep the record; recipient reads it read-only
TC-07/S16.detail: Both contexts: Send to… → exact email → 'Send to <email>?' → 'Sent to <email>'; no mailto. Sender: one Sent record (kind tasks) naming the recipient with the send time; Handoffs → Sent 'To <recipient> · <time>' + 'Task list' badge. Recipient: one Received record naming the sender, same time; opens the same grouped text (pending groups + COMPLETED block); only Back and Copy on the page (read-only). Recipient's own lists and task views gain nothing. 19/19 judged. Not testable locally (Manual): the sent list 35 h / 37 h after sending (handoffs.send stamps server time; no aging helper; OAT-04 / Q7).
